accent.$description: The lifted navy, the accent on dark: 5.22:1 on the canvas, 4.63:1 on the surface (ADR-0007).

accent-hover.$description: Hover state of accent-coloured controls on dark, 6.98:1 on the canvas (ADR-0007).

accent-pale.$description: The lifted navy at 18 % for a highlighted row, tag or state (ADR-0007).

accent-pale-2.$description: The lifted navy at 10 %, the quieter fill (ADR-0007).

accent-highlight.$description: The light navy for large highlighted title text: 8.71:1 on the canvas, 7.73:1 on the surface (ADR-0007).

on-accent.$description: Near-black on the lifted accent, 5.22:1; white on it is 3.48:1 and is never used (ADR-0007).

ink.$description: Warm white, primary text: 16.48:1 on the canvas, 14.62:1 on the surface (ADR-0007).

muted.$description: Secondary text: 11.13:1 on the canvas, 9.88:1 on the surface (ADR-0007).

tertiary.$description: Tertiary text, captions and footers: 6.25:1 on the canvas, 5.54:1 on the surface (ADR-0007).

decoration.$description: Non-text decoration only, never text: 3.81:1 on the canvas, 3.38:1 on the surface (ADR-0007).

canvas.$description: A near-black with a navy cast, the background of every dark page (ADR-0007).

surface.$description: Cards and panels on a dark page (ADR-0007).

surface-alt.$description: Recessed surface on dark: table headers, grouped areas (ADR-0007).

desk.$description: On screen only, around a dark page preview (ADR-0007).

border.$description: Borders and dividers on dark, white at 14 % (decorative, ADR-0007).

border-light.$description: Hairlines and card borders on dark, white at 10 % (decorative, ADR-0007).

border-strong.$description: Outline of outlined and dashed state marks on dark: 6.03:1 on the canvas, 5.35:1 on the surface (ADR-0007).

panel-start.$description: Light end of the navy panel gradient on dark, white 8.23:1 on it (ADR-0007).

panel-end.$description: Dark end of the navy panel gradient on dark (ADR-0007).

success.$description: Apps only: success on dark, 8.09:1 on the canvas (ADR-0007, ADR-0004).

warning.$description: Apps only: warning text, icons and borders on dark, 8.00:1 on the canvas (ADR-0007, ADR-0004).

danger.$description: Apps only: errors and destructive actions on dark, 6.53:1 on the canvas (ADR-0007, ADR-0004).

info.$description: Apps only: information on dark, 7.25:1 on the canvas (ADR-0007, ADR-0004).

on-warning-fill.$description: Near-black on the warning fill, 6.18:1; warm white on it is 2.67:1 (ADR-0007).

warning-fill.$description: The warning fill, unchanged on dark (ADR-0007).

warning-tint.$description: The warning fill at 16 % behind ink text, 11.63:1 on the surface (ADR-0007).

dim.$description: Retired name of the old tertiary grey; resolves to tertiary on dark too (ADR-0007).
dim.$deprecated: Use --mq-tertiary for text or --mq-decoration for non-text decoration.

accent.$description: The one-off accent on the dark navy panel, 4.64:1 on its light end (owner ruling of 2026-10-17, ADR-0007).

discreet.$description: Discreet numbers on the dark navy panel, 3.37:1 on its light end, so large text or non-text only (owner ruling of 2026-10-17, ADR-0007).

accent-on-dark.$description: Retired name of the accent on navy; resolves to the on-navy accent on dark too (owner ruling of 2026-10-17, ADR-0007).
accent-on-dark.$deprecated: Use --mq-on-navy-title for titles and rules, --mq-on-navy-accent for the one-off accent.
